parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is offering Claude a trade (2 Wheat for 1 Sheep) right after blocking him. This is a classic move to soften the blow, but it also helps Claude get closer to a city. Since I also need Sheep and have Wheat, I should remind Jimmy that Claude is still the main threat.
parsed.note_to_self: Jimmy is trading with Claude despite the robber placement. This confirms they are still willing to cooperate. Claude needs Sheep for a city/settlement.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, אתה בטוח שאתה רוצה לתת לקלוד בדיוק את מה שהוא צריך לעיר אחרי שחסמת אותו? הוא יחזור למשחק מהר מאוד ככה.
